issues.explanation: Serve component has invalid PHP syntax with double backslashes so it cannot run.
Neither mount authorizes (Queues should authorize create on Queue, Serve should authorize view on entity) and no route middleware enforces it.
Waiting list resolves scoped queue with findOrFail and never checks call authorization, so foreign ids 404 instead of showing empty and unauthorized queues leak tickets.
Members tabs feature is completely absent: no change to Members component and missing members_tab_members/members_tab_invites keys.
Rename passes null for slug instead of re-deriving slug from the new name, so renaming Old to New does not yield slug new.
Detail modal calls toggleActive directly and never calls confirmToggle, bypassing the required confirmation modal flow.
Contract requires view data accessQueue and accessGrants but component exposes accessQueue() and hasAccessGrant() methods with no render data and no accessGrants collection.
lastCalledTicketId is a writable public property and mode has no validation, so client can tamper with served state and CallMode::from throws on bad input.
callNext has no rate limiting for successful calls per user and entity.
No #[Validate] attributes and no $this->validate() calls, so domain validation errors cannot be surfaced on name or renameName.
Change ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests and therefore no unauthorized-call or tamper tests for Livewire actions.
openQueue and openAccess store raw client ids without scoped findOrFail resolution, contrary to every-id-untrusted rule.
closeQueue does not reset accessQueueId and managingAccess nested state.
Duplicate queues_activate key defined twice in both locales.
Serve view uses hardcoded English labels and missing aria-label on call button instead of lang keys and accessible labels.
hasAccessGrant queries QueueAccess per membership causing N+1 instead of reusing accessGrants collection.

conventions.evidence: Uses CreateQueue/UpdateQueue/SetQueueAccess/CallNextTicket per app/Livewire/Entity/Queues.php:57 but has no #[Validate]+$this->validate(), no $this->authorize(), no tests/docs, duplicate lang keys at lang/en/ui.php:282

readability.evidence: Hardcoded 'Select Queue'/'Mode' labels in serve.blade.php:43, duplicate queues_activate keys, invalid '\\Illuminate' type at Serve.php:217, inconsistent style

requirements.evidence: Serve.php:217 invalid '\\Illuminate' syntax; Members tabs untouched and members_tab_* keys missing; rename at Queues.php:94 passes null slug; detail modal at queues.blade.php:440 bypasses confirmToggle

scope.evidence: Diff touches only queues/serve/routes/lang/navbar for the task with no unrelated refactors; extra serve_title/ticket_* keys are task-adjacent

security.evidence: No authorize in Queues.php:38 or Serve.php:200; Serve.php:224 lists tickets without call check; public lastCalledTicketId/viewingQueueId/accessQueueId unlocked and unvalidated

simplicity.evidence: Direct Eloquent/Actions code with no speculative layers; minor duplication (duplicate lang keys) and per-membership query in hasAccessGrant at Queues.php:156

tests.evidence: No tests/* files in change.diff; no happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call or tamper tests for Queues or Serve

review.summary: Adds Queues and Serve Livewire components with routes, views, lang keys and navbar links, but the Serve component has syntax errors, authorization/validation/rate-limiting are missing, the toggle confirmation flow is bypassed, and the Members tabs feature is absent, so the change must be rejected.
